title: 3EN Agent v2.2 smoke test
description: Create a backup directory, write a test file, verify it exists, and provide rollback.
backup: $BackupDir = 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupDir | Out-Null; Write-Host "Backup directory ready: $BackupDir"
script: $TestFile = 'C:\3EN-Agent\agent-v2-test.txt'; "3EN Agent v2.2 OK - $(Get-Date -Format o)" | Set-Content -Path $TestFile -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Created: $TestFile"
test: $TestFile = 'C:\3EN-Agent\agent-v2-test.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $TestFile)) { throw 'Test file does not exist' }; Get-Content $TestFile
